title: NT Intertextuality Detector
description: A semantic search tool that surfaces Old Testament quotations, allusions, and echoes within the book of Romans using sentence-transformer embeddings and FAISS vector similarity search.

title: Diabetes Self-Test
description: A machine learning web application that predicts diabetes risk from clinical features using a Support Vector Machine trained on patient data, with 78% accuracy on held-out test samples.

title: TextScape
description: An interactive 3D visualization tool that maps documents by semantic similarity using embedding models, enabling spatial exploration of conceptual relationships across large text corpora.

title: Victorian Simplicity
description: An exhibition website presenting a counter-narrative of the Victorian Era — exploring the argument that, beneath its ornate surface, the period embodied a fundamental simplicity.
